scoring_justification: Effective elastic constants are compared against paper-derived hidden reference values (T0) with tolerance; fracture artifacts are verified by structural ordering (T3) as recomputing from raw fracture data is not feasible within the verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference effective moduli (K, G) for bi-continuous and particulate systems at volume fractions 0.2,0.5,0.8 with interface types 1 and 2, approximated from paper Figures 4 and 6.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values read from the figures and hardcoded as approximate table; used by reference solve.sh and hidden checker.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper-reported approximate values for the main elastic result, not invented; they are traceable to the paper's own plots and match the reference solve.sh's code comments.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference crack surface ratios (inclusion_ratio, matrix_ratio, total_ratio) for the three particulate microstructures.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text statistics given for crack surfaces
hidden_assets.generation_method: Exact values from the paper's text: ratios 1.2%, 1.3%, 1.6% for inclusion, 9.6%, 10.5%, 12.7% for matrix, 5.4%, 5.9%, 7.2% total.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly quoted from the paper, used only as a loose range check (not as a tight target) to ensure the reported ordering is plausible.

outputs.description: Effective bulk modulus K and shear modulus G for all composite types, volume fractions, and interface types. Values are compared against hidden paper-derived references within tolerance.
Crack surface voxel ratios for the three particulate microstructures. The checker verifies the ordering: total crack surface ratio increases from microstructure 1 to 2 to 3.
Reaction force vs. applied strain curves for the three microstructures. The checker verifies that the extracted peak reaction force increases in the order microstructure 1 < 2 < 3.

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the full lattice model, microstructure generation, and solvers from the method description. The scored artifacts are derived from full simulation runs; no pre-made model parameters or simulation results are provided.
